commits.subject: Name Ultra-Regular as the release does
commits.body:
The release's names differ from what FontForge exported from this file;
it states them as US English names: ID 4 'Ultra Regular' (FontForge exported 'Ultra'); ID 6 'Ultra-Regular' (FontForge exported 'Ultra').

disclose: The released font has only a legacy `kern` table and no GPOS. fontc writes kerning as GPOS, and a font with GPOS no longer gets HarfBuzz's built-in placement of combining marks, so combining marks are positioned differently from the release (e.g. U+0312, U+0326, U+0315). Decided 2026-10-01: accept and disclose.
